name: SSO Authentication
description: Sign in to Jellyfin through an OpenID Connect or SAML identity provider.
overview: Authenticate users against an SSO provider.

versions.changelog:
Redesign permission editor, preview, and account pages

Permission editor
- Replace the "Edit permissions for" dropdown with one rule list:
  Everyone first, then groups, a divider, then user overrides. Each
  row shows a one-line summary; the selected rule opens in a card
  below the list.

Preview
- Show "When <user> signs in" with matching groups, whether a user
  override applies, and only the permissions that change (before ->
  after, with the responsible rule).
- Show libraries as tags marking added and removed ones, including
  losing "All libraries" (new CurrentAll field in the preview response).
- Fold the full permission table under "All permissions" and drop the
  explanatory footer note from the UI and the API response.

Sign-in completion page
- Center the page with the Jellyfin logo, a spinner, and success or
  error states styled like the Jellyfin 12 web client.

Account connections
- Record the provider username, issuer, link time, and last sign-in for
  each verified link (SubjectLinkDetails). Preserve them across
  dashboard saves, prune them with their link, and remove them on unlink.
- Add ?details=true to the links endpoint and show these details, plus
  the groups from the last sign-in, on the linking page.
- Add a user settings menu entry for Account connections through the
  File Transformation plugin, only when it is installed.
- Allow same-origin images in the standalone pages' CSP for the logo.

Tests and docs
- Cover link details and the menu script; update browser tests for the
  rule list, the new preview, and the completion text; check the linking
  page shows account details.
- Document the rule list, the preview, linking details, the menu entry,
  and the links ?details=true option.

Validate provider settings and resolve SSO follow-ups

  - Preserve original sign-in errors when logout cleanup fails
  - Diagnose missing and invalid SAML certificates
  - Validate enabled provider settings and callback ports before saving
  - Preserve legacy configurations, port sentinels, and disabled drafts
  - Support whole-URL avatar claims and trim fallback provider IDs
  - Add opt-in ZITADEL role mapping scoped to allowed organizations
  - Update documentation, regression tests, and TODO completion status
fix: docs regarding migration, and remove unused code.
Forward WebSockets in test proxy and keep a live session for host restriction checks
